fit: Direct controlled workflow comparison: common GPT-4.1 backend, tools and scoring across ten reasoning/coding/tool-use benchmarks; six MAS versus one task-level controller.
evidence: v2: ChatEval uses 4.34x Core tokens, LLM-Debate 1.39x; EvoAgent pooled accuracy 79.70% versus Core 76.65%.
limitations: Recorded cumulative input/output tokens, not peak context occupancy. Nine broad-suite tasks only expose Python; HotpotQA and separate GAIA checks use expanded tools. Core can delegate search; single agent means one task controller. Missing usage not imputed; external-runtime case study budgets not matched.
context_metric: Cumulative recorded input plus output tokens across calls/roles, under common Core step limits; not equalized realized expenditure.
